desc:
🐙 MECHANICAL TENTACLES [UPDATE]

Ever wanted arms that can punch through buildings, scale skyscrapers, and yeet your friends across the map? Now you can. This is a physics-based sandbox built around fully procedural mechanical tentacles — grab, climb, smash, throw, repeat.

🎮 PC Controls
Q — Grab anything, players included. Click again to throw.
R — Switch into tentacle-walking mode (wall climbing included).
Shift — Sprint. Run into a wall to keep running up it.
Space (hold) — Charge up a super jump.
T — Stash your tentacles into backpack.

💎 VIP Pass
Unlocks the Settings menu, so you can:
— run with up to 6 tentacles at once
— unlock the massive "Giant" tentacle size
— fully recolor your left and right tentacles

Drop a like and favorite if you're having fun — more mechanics coming soon.
